recovery_rule: A recovery is additive and never erases or relabels a failed witness.

x2_operational_failures.failed_witness: first combined Python functional-smoke wrapper had an unterminated quoted literal
x2_operational_failures.recovery: use a bounded expression-only smoke without nested quoted source
